items.title: How MongoDB Fits into the EU Sovereign Cloud Ecosystem
items.summary: The question of what the term “sovereign cloud” means in Europe has moved from policy debates to formal European Commission (EC) procurement frameworks and industrial investments. The Cloud Sovereignty Framework (CSF), Sovereignty Effectiveness Assurance Levels (SEAL), and the developing EU Cybersecurity Certification Scheme for Cloud Services (EUCS) are separate initiatives that provide distinct reference points. items.title: Introducing the MongoDB Claude SDK Session Adapter: Durable Session Storage for Agents
items.summary: The Claude Agent SDK is a package that lets you embed Claude Code's own agent loop directly into your application: web search, file search, file editing, MCP server connections, and more, all without having to define those tools or manage the agent loop yourself. The SDK also automatically persists session transcripts to the local file system by default. Claude calls it the Agent SessionStore.
